faq.default_text: Answers to the most common questions about the registration process, support timelines, and working with our company

1.question: How long does product registration take?
1.answer: The registration process typically takes between 6 and 24 months depending on the product category, completeness of the registration dossier, the need for additional studies, and current regulatory requirements.
1.leftText: We assess the documentation, product category, and possible approval stages in advance so the client understands the realistic registration path.

2.question: What product categories does MAXIPHARM work with?
2.answer: The company supports registration of medicines, medical devices, dietary supplements, and cosmetic products, and provides expert support on clinical trial matters.
2.leftText: MAXIPHARM supports projects in pharmaceuticals and medical technologies where precision, documentation, and regulatory expertise are critical.

3.question: What does comprehensive support include?
3.answer: Comprehensive support includes document analysis, registration dossier preparation, submission to the competent authorities, support throughout the review process, and completion of the registration procedure.
3.leftText: The client receives systematic support at every stage: from reviewing source materials to completing the registration process.

4.question: Can I request only a specific service?
4.answer: Yes. MAXIPHARM provides both full-cycle support and expert assistance for individual areas — dossier preparation, document analysis, and regulatory consultations.
4.leftText: If you need help at just one stage, we can join a specific task without full project support.

5.question: How does the company help reduce the risk of rejection or delays?
5.answer: Through thorough document analysis, correct dossier preparation, and project support in line with current requirements, our specialists help minimize regulatory risks.
5.leftText: We identify weaknesses in documentation early and help reduce the likelihood of revisions, delays, and rejections.

6.question: How do I start working with you?
6.answer: Cooperation begins with an initial consultation, product category analysis, and assessment of the current state of documentation, after which a support strategy is developed.
6.leftText: We start with an initial task analysis, then form a clear action plan, timeline, and support format.

header.title: REGULATORY SUPPORT FOR PHARMACEUTICAL PRODUCTS
header.subtitle: We help pharmaceutical companies complete the registration of medicines and medical devices — from dossier preparation to obtaining the registration certificate

drug-registration.text: Drug registration — comprehensive support for the state registration of pharmaceutical products in accordance with current regulatory requirements. The service includes preparation and formatting of the registration dossier, analysis and systematization of documentation, interaction with government authorities, expert review support, and advisory assistance at all stages of registration, re-registration, and amendments

medical-devices.text: Full professional support for the registration of medical devices, equipment, and medical-purpose products. Includes documentation analysis, risk class determination, registration dossier preparation, organization of required testing, and interaction with regulatory authorities. We ensure compliance with legislative requirements, minimize rejection risks, and reduce registration timelines for manufacturers and suppliers

bad-registration.text: Professional support for the registration of dietary supplements (DSs) in accordance with current sanitary and regulatory requirements. Includes composition and documentation analysis, registration dossier preparation, required expert reviews, and interaction with authorized bodies. We ensure product compliance with established standards, reduce rejection risks, and accelerate the registration process for market entry

cosmetics-registration.text: Professional support for the registration and declaration of cosmetic products in accordance with technical regulations and sanitary requirements. Includes composition and labeling analysis, preparation of a complete documentation package, required testing, and interaction with regulatory authorities. We ensure product compliance with standards, reduce rejection risks, and accelerate market entry

clinical-research.text: Professional support for the planning and conduct of clinical trials of medicines and medical devices in accordance with international and national standards (GCP). Includes protocol development, documentation preparation, selection of research centers, coordination of trial processes, data quality monitoring, and interaction with regulatory authorities. We ensure correctness, transparency, and compliance of all stages with regulatory requirements for successful product registration

regulatory-consulting.text: Professional guidance on product compliance with the requirements of regulatory authorities in the fields of pharmaceuticals, medical devices, dietary supplements, and cosmetics. Includes regulatory framework analysis, product and documentation assessment, development of registration and market entry strategies, and advisory support at all stages of interaction with regulators. We ensure reduction of regulatory risks, process optimization, and faster receipt of authorization documents
